title: grammitis minor
intro: Grammitis minor, commonly known as the Lesser Grammitis, is a species of fern in the family Polypodiaceae. It is traditionally used in herbal medicine for its various health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving respiratory issues, and aiding in the treatment of fever. The therapeutic actions of Grammitis minor include its anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and expectorant properties, which help to soothe and calm the body. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
